what: On first open, a large logo cell (26.875×5.75rem) stands at the top left of the curtain covering the screen, and the logo inside rises from below .5s later over 1s power2.inOut. A 4px bar at the very bottom fills over 3.8s power2.inOut while the number at bottom left counts 00 → 100. Once the bar is full and the document has arrived, the number group slides down 2rem while fading over .3s. The logo cell folds to the header logo size (7.375×1.625rem) over 1s, and the curtain lifts .15s later over .3s — the logo is the star of the loading screen and then simply becomes the header logo. fx:done fires at .5s (hooks the title rise, etc.)

options.dur: Bar and number duration (seconds), default 3.8 — 0 jumps straight to the end state
options.to: Size the logo cell folds to (width height), default 7.375rem 1.625rem
options.out: Duration of digits/curtain fading out (sec), default .3
options.[data-fx-part=veil · logo · mark · fill: Curtain · logo cell (fixed, large size in css) · logo inside the cell · bar · number · pieces of the number group that disappears
options.fx:done: .5s after the curtain starts lifting — put the first entrance motion here

use: □00
note: If there is a logo Lottie, run it separately inside mark (in the original it can’t find the Lottie on wide screens so it doesn’t spin — see the reference site’s shared.js)

from.where: shared.js preloader — original first-page loader: .preloader-bar-fill 3.8s power2.inOut · 2-digit counter, logo yPercent 100 → 0 over 1s (after .5s), closes with counterWrap > * y 2rem·opacity 0 .3s · .preloader-logo-wrapper 7.375×1.625rem 1s power2.inOut · overlay opacity 0 .3s(.15s), starts appearing at .5s
